name: nft-policy-drop-accept-below-drop
description: policy drop, an accept for the peer, but a drop above it
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy drop; }"
nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.5.5.2 accept
